nodes.text: A fictional, single-site, single-day observation statement.
The fixture reports 12 visits at Site A on Tuesday.
All sites always receive more visits on Tuesdays than on other days.
nodes.failure_mode_notes: A single fictional site-day is generalized across all sites and days.

nodes.text: At Site A, Tuesday visit counts may exceed other weekdays over repeated weeks.
Tuesdays are generally the busiest day.
component_claims: A Tuesday advantage generalizes across sites and weeks.

nodes.text: The fixture mentions Tuesday but makes no weekday comparison.
A one-day count cannot establish a weekday advantage.
nodes.why_risky: The source contains no comparison days or additional sites.
nodes.suggested_patch: Restrict the statement to the recorded fictional site-day; retain any recurring pattern as an untested question.
nodes.failure_mode_notes: The risk concerns the overclaim, not the truth of this warning.

nodes.text: A matched multiweek comparison may fail to show the proposed Tuesday advantage.
nodes.required_evidence: Daily visit counts at Site A with opening hours, promotions, and events recorded.

test_plan.measurement: Compare Tuesday and other weekday visit rates per open hour at Site A across eight weeks, adjusting for recorded promotions and events.
test_plan.weakening_result: An adjusted Tuesday difference at or below zero with adequate precision would weaken the proposed advantage; an imprecise result remains unresolved.
test_plan.alternative_explanation: Longer opening hours or Tuesday promotions, rather than the weekday itself, may explain a difference.
